reviews.title: Good memory if it doesn't get shipped in the same bag as the power supply
reviews.comment: Been working good for the last year, no issues.  It took about 5-6 minutes to train the memory on first boot, which was not something I was aware of initially for DDR5 memory.  The memory comes in a small plastic container and it was shipped in a amazon bag with my power supply !?!.  One of the modules had a 15° bend and shockingly did not work.  Returned for a new set and the new set worked correctly.  Unfortunate its now 3.5x the price it was last year but functionally is a solid buy.

reviews.title: Great Value and High Quality all in one Package!
reviews.comment: My Dell XPS 8960 came with 32GB of memory (Ram) and a few years ago that was a lot of memory. However I often found myself pushing the 32GB limit of the XPS. So the first place I went was to Amazon to see what Crucial had to offer. I've had really good luck with every Crucial product I've bought and this 32GB memory card was no exception. It matched all the factory card specs and it inserted easily into the socket. After installation it integrated seamlessly with the XPS and I had no connection issues. During a recent heavy workload on my PC I was using  right at 32GB but I didn't even notice it with the additional memory. Another quality product from Crucial
